title: Colorful Graphic Eyeliner on HOODED EYES /DOWNTURNED EYES Tutorial
description:
Hey everyone welcome to my channel! I am Hajar a Makeup Artist and Online Makeup Instructor! In today's tutorial, I want to demonstrate the easy application of colorful graphic eyeliner. Of course, you can go for your classic black eyeliner as well when using this eyeliner technique. This eyeliner technique helps to lift and elongate hooded/ droopy and downturned eyes so that they look more bright and wide open!  I hope you enjoy this step-by-step 5-minute tutorial and if you did please like and share it with your friends and family!
